name: goal-decomposition
description: Decompose strategic goals into sub-goals and operational / measurable criteria. Builds a goal tree (vision → strategic → tactical → operational) with parent-child relationships, measurable criteria per goal, owners, timelines, and dependencies. Supports GQM (Goal-Question-Metric), i* actor goals, and means-ends decomposition. Feeds okr-definition, metric-definition, and roadmap skills. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
